components.title: Exact coherent engine identity allowlist
components.summary: Requires the full 1ec00cf canonical catalogue identity and exact Recoil source before admitting a source candidate ceiling of Count 1, 2, or 4.

flows.title: Manifest source identity to bounded catalogue admission

steps.description: Require the exact catalogue string and full Recoil 1ec00cf source SHA in the candidate manifest.
Admit only the candidate profile with ceiling 1, 2, or 4 and bounded packet/run identities.
Require every completed catalogue page to advertise the exact coherent engine version before factory policy admission.

facts.statement: FSBar freezes the full 1ec00cf canonical catalogue string and the private manifest parser separately requires full Recoil source SHA 1ec00cfadab407df1dc03d8756b827990f6847fc.
Candidate admission permits only ceiling Count 1, 2, or 4. Test source asserts the final identity and separately names the historical 8a and interim 25f6 identities as refusal cases.

The accepted FSBar report records a clean solution build and passing browser, manifest, IPC, observer, and public-surface source gates. These are source and contract checks; they do not qualify rebuilt artifacts or private runtime pins.

The exact-source allowlist does not establish private pin admission, genuine native Count 1, 2, or 4 behavior, paired peer equality, replay/save-load, callback atomicity, cleanup, useful play, installation, or publication.
